Owned test fixture: generated with Calibre's existing FontBuilder/TTGlyphPen; 95 ASCII mappings use rectangular outlines, space has no outline. Family CWNG Test Font, Regular. Public domain fixture; no third-party font bytes. The browser tests append a unique owned-user marker to the SFNT payload to avoid shared-catalog cross-project dedup/deletion races, and compare delivered bytes to exactly those uploaded. Used only for real parser/font loading proof, not typeface quality or legibility endorsement.
